run_repeat_lines_to_file: run the script to repeat each line of an input file N times and write to an output file
run_repeat_lines_to_stdout: run the script to repeat each line of an input file N times and print to stdout
run_normalize_spaces: run the script to normalize whitespace in each line of an input file before repeating
test_repeat_lines_cli: test the repeat lines CLI tool by providing an input file and repeat count
review_repeat_lines_main: review the main function that reads an input file and repeats each line a specified number of times
